|translation='''Title:''' The obstruction is cleared!

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: Cancel I'm On The Leader (not affected by Sense).

2: Use 1 Force to move one TIE at Death Star: Trench to the Death Star system card (it moves for free). Also, if the lead starfighter is piloted by its matching pilot, you may add 1 to the total of Attack Run.

'''Lore:'''
“Come on, blow this big thing already and let's go back to base!”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 邪魔者は片づいたぞ！ (the obstruction is cleared). The Japanese numbers the two options.
